scanNote:
4-UNITNING BIRINCHI BETI (26-bet). Yuqori qismi TO'Q YASHIL fonli.

Yuqorida chapda qora harflar bilan 'UNIT 4' (birinchi rasm ustida). O'rtada katta PUSHTI bo'rtma harflar bilan 'Days to Remember'.

YETTITA CHIZMA RASM (raqamlangan kvadrat yorliqlar bilan):

1 - Sariq sochli ayol (Janice) yashil kofta va jinsida divanda o'tirib televizor ko'rmoqda.
2 - Eshik oldida: jigarrang paltodagi, oq ko'ylakli, sochi tepaga yig'ilgan yosh ayol qo'lida oq guldasta ushlab turibdi; Janice unga qarab turibdi.
3 - Janice telefonda gaplashmoqda; tepasida fikr pufakchasida ESKI qora TAKSI rasmi.
4 - Ochiq eshik; ostonada guldasta YoTIBDI; Janice zinapoyada turibdi.
5 - Janice zinapoyada guldastani ushlab yig'lab o'tiribdi; o'ngda qora paltodagi erkak (James) eshikdan kirmoqda.
6 - Xonada James paltoda; javon ustida SOAT va ramkali ESKI SURAT bor.
7 - Divanda Janice va James; James devordagi to'y suratini ko'rsatmoqda.

Pastda oq fonda:
• To'q sariq 'Lead-in' sarlavhasi.
1) 'Match the sentences (a - g) to the pictures (1 - 7). Then, read out the events in the correct order. Can you guess who the young woman was?' Yettita gap, har birining oldida harf va KATAKChA; katakchalarga QO'LDA raqamlar yozilgan (a-2, b-4, c-7, d-1, e-5, f-3, g-6).
2) 'Guess the type of story. Is it a humorous story, a science fiction story, a crime story, a horror story, a love story, a ghost story or a fairy tale?'
O'ng ustunda: 'Who are the characters in the story? What do you think it is about? Describe what you can see in the pictures.'
3) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Listen to the story and check if your guesses were correct.'
• To'q sariq 'Reading' sarlavhasi.
4) 'Read the story and match the sentences (A - D) to the numbered spaces (1 - 4) in the story, then explain the words in bold.' To'rtta gap: A, B, C, D.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '26'.

⚠ Hikoyaning MATNI keyingi betda (27-bet).

exercises.instructionEn: Match the sentences (a - g) to the pictures (1 - 7). Then, read out the events in the correct order. Can you guess who the young woman was?
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni (a - g) rasmlarga (1 - 7) moslang. So'ng voqealarni to'g'ri tartibda o'qing. Yosh ayol kim ekanini taxmin qila olasizmi?
exercises.explanationUz:
YETTI RASM - YETTI VOQEA.


TO'G'RI TARTIB (rasm raqami bo'yicha):

  1 - d  Janice was watching TV.
  2 - a  Janice saw a young woman
         standing at the door.
  3 - f  Janice went to the telephone
         and asked the local taxi service
         to collect the young woman.
  4 - b  The woman's flowers were lying
         on the doormat.
  5 - e  When James got home, she was
         still sitting on the stairs with
         the flowers on her lap.
  6 - g  James noticed an old photograph.
  7 - c  James showed Janice the
         photograph.


⚠ YoSh AYoL KIM EDI:

  Rasmlarga qarang: 7-rasmda James
  ESKI SURATNI ko'rsatadi va Janice
  hayratda qoladi.

  ⚠ Demak suratdagi ayol - eshik oldida
  turgan yosh ayolning O'ZI.
  ⚠ Bu - ARVOH hikoyasi ('a ghost
  story') - 2-mashqning javobi.


⚠ MATNDAGI ZAMONLAR:

  PAST CONTINUOUS (davomli):
     'Janice WAS WATCHING TV.'
     'The flowers WERE LYING on the
      doormat.'
     'she WAS STILL SITTING on the
      stairs'

  PAST SIMPLE (bir martalik ish):
     'Janice SAW a young woman.'
     'Janice WENT to the telephone.'
     'James NOTICED an old photograph.'
     'James SHOWED Janice the
      photograph.'

  ⚠ Bu - 4-unitning grammatika mavzusi:
  past simple va past continuous farqi.


⚠ 'TO SEE SB DOING STH':

  'Janice saw a young woman STANDING at
   the door.'
  = turgan ayolni ko'rdi.

  ⚠ Ko'rish/eshitish fe'llaridan keyin
  -ING shakli JARAYoNNI bildiradi.


⚠ 'TO LIE' - IKKI XIL:

  'The flowers were LYING on the mat.'
  ⚠ lie - lay - lain (yotmoq)
  ⚠ -ING shakli: LYING ('lieing' XATO)

  ⚠ 17-betdagi maqolda ham 'lie' bor edi:
  'so you must lie upon it'.


⚠ 'A LAP':

  = tizza usti (o'tirganda).
  ⚠ 'with the flowers on her LAP' =
  gullar tizzasida.


⚠ 'TO COLLECT':

  = olib ketmoq, borib olmoq.
  ⚠ 'to collect sb' = kimnidir borib
  olmoq (mashinada).
  ⚠ Boshqa ma'nosi: to'plamoq
  (19-betda 'collectors' bor edi).

pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 1-rasmda Janice divanda o'tirib televizor
ko'rmoqda.
⚠ PAST CONTINUOUS - davom etayotgan ish.

pairs.left: a  Janice saw a young woman standing at the door.
pairs.leftUz: Janice eshik oldida turgan yosh ayolni ko'rdi.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 2-rasmda eshik oldida guldastali yosh ayol.
⚠ 'saw sb STANDING' - -ING shakli jarayonni
bildiradi.

pairs.left: f  Janice went to the telephone and asked the local taxi service to collect the young woman.
pairs.leftUz: Janice telefonga bordi va mahalliy taksi xizmatidan yosh ayolni olib ketishni so'radi.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 3-rasmda Janice telefonda gaplashmoqda;
fikr pufakchasida TAKSI.
⚠ 'to ask sb TO DO sth' - infinitiv bilan.
⚠ 'to collect sb' = borib olmoq.

pairs.left: b  The woman's flowers were lying on the doormat.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 4-rasmda ostonada guldasta yotibdi, ayol
yo'q.
⚠ 'lying' - 'lie' fe'lining -ING shakli
('lieing' XATO).
⚠ 'a doormat' - 21-betdagi Harrods matnida ham
bor edi.

pairs.left: e  When James got home, she was still sitting on the stairs with the flowers on her lap.
pairs.leftUz: Jeyms uyga kelganda, u hamon zinapoyada gullar tizzasida o'tirardi.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 5-rasmda Janice zinapoyada yig'lab o'tiribdi,
Jeyms kirmoqda.
⚠ PAST SIMPLE ('got') + PAST CONTINUOUS
('was sitting') - 4-unitning grammatikasi.
⚠ 'a lap' = tizza usti.

pairs.left: g  James noticed an old photograph.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 6-rasmda javon ustidagi soat yonida ramkali
eski surat.
⚠ 'to notice' = payqamoq.

pairs.left: c  James showed Janice the photograph.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 7-rasmda Jeyms devordagi suratni ko'rsatmoqda.
⚠ 'to show sb sth' - IKKI to'ldiruvchi,
predlogsiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Guess the type of story. Is it a humorous story, a science fiction story, a crime story, a horror story, a love story, a ghost story or a fairy tale? Who are the characters in the story? What do you think it is about? Describe what you can see in the pictures.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoya turini taxmin qiling. Bu kulgili hikoyami, ilmiy-fantastikmi, jinoiy hikoyami, qo'rqinchli hikoyami, sevgi hikoyasimi, arvoh haqidagi hikoyami yoki ertakmi? Hikoyadagi qahramonlar kim? Sizningcha, u nima haqida? Rasmlarda nima ko'rayotganingizni tasvirlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
HIKOYa TURLARI.

  a humorous story - kulgili hikoya
  a science fiction story - ilmiy-
     fantastik hikoya
  a crime story - jinoiy hikoya
  a horror story - qo'rqinchli hikoya
  a love story - sevgi hikoyasi
  a ghost story - arvoh haqidagi hikoya
  a fairy tale - ertak


⚠ QAYSI TUR:

  Rasmlarga qarang:
     • yosh ayol paydo bo'ladi va
       G'OYIB bo'ladi (2 va 4-rasm)
     • gullar qoladi
     • ESKI suratda o'sha ayol

  → Bu - GHOST STORY (arvoh haqidagi
  hikoya).


⚠ SO'ZLARNING TAHLILI:

  'humorous' - 'humour' (hazil) so'zidan
  ⚠ Britaniyada 'humour', AQShda 'humor',
  lekin sifat IKKALASIDA ham 'humorous'.

  'science fiction' - 'science' (fan) +
     'fiction' (badiiy to'qima)
  ⚠ Qisqartmasi: 'sci-fi' /ˌsaɪ ˈfaɪ/.

  'a crime' = jinoyat
  ⚠ 'a criminal' = jinoyatchi.

  'horror' = dahshat
  ⚠ 'horrible' = dahshatli.

  'a ghost' = arvoh, ruh
  ⚠ 'gh' - 'g' o'qiladi, 'h' JIM:
  /ɡəʊst/.

  'a fairy tale' = ertak
  ⚠ 'a fairy' = pari; 'a tale' = ertak,
  qissa.


⚠ 'A CHARACTER' - IKKI MA'NO:

  1) qahramon (kitobda, filmda)
  2) xarakter, xislat (6-betda shu
     ma'noda edi)

  ⚠ Bu yerda BIRINChI ma'no.

items.answerEn: I think it is a ghost story, because the young woman appears and then disappears, and she is in an old photograph.
items.answerUz: Menimcha, bu arvoh haqidagi hikoya, chunki yosh ayol paydo bo'ladi va g'oyib bo'ladi, keyin eski suratda ko'rinadi.

items.en: Who are the characters in the story?
items.answerEn: Janice, her husband James, and a young woman with flowers.
items.answerUz: Janice, uning turmush o'rtog'i Jeyms va guldastali yosh ayol.

items.en: What do you think it is about?
items.answerEn: I think it is about a young woman who comes to the door and then disappears, leaving her flowers behind.
items.answerUz: Menimcha, u eshikka kelgan va gullarini qoldirib g'oyib bo'lgan yosh ayol haqida.

items.en: Describe what you can see in the pictures.
items.answerEn: In the first picture a woman is watching TV. In the second one she sees a young woman with flowers at the door. In the last picture her husband is showing her an old photograph.
items.answerUz: Birinchi rasmda ayol televizor ko'rmoqda. Ikkinchisida u eshik oldida guldastali yosh ayolni ko'radi. Oxirgi rasmda turmush o'rtog'i unga eski suratni ko'rsatmoqda.

exercises.audioRequiredUz: Hikoya avval AUDIODA tinglanadi - taxminlarni tekshirish uchun yozuv kerak. Matnning o'zi 27-betda bor.
exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the story and check if your guesses were correct.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoyani tinglang va taxminlaringiz to'g'ri ekanini tekshiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
TAXMIN QILIB, KEYIN TEKShIRISh.

  ⚠ Bu usul 'predict and check' deb
  ataladi: avval rasm va sarlavhaga
  qarab TAXMIN qilinadi, keyin
  tinglab yoki o'qib TEKShIRILADI.

  ⚠ Taxmin qilgan o'quvchi matnni
  ancha yaxshi tushunadi - chunki u
  ALLAQAChON javob izlayotgan bo'ladi.

  * ⚠ Kassetada hikoya o'qiladi -
    lekin matnning O'ZI 27-betda bor,
    shuning uchun tekshirish audiosiz
    ham mumkin.


⚠ 'IF' - IKKI MA'NO:

  1) AGAR (shart):
     'If it rains, we'll stay at home.'
  2) ...MI (o'zlashtirma so'roq):
     'Check IF your guesses were correct.'
     = taxminlaringiz to'g'ri ekanINI
       tekshiring

  ⚠ Ikkinchi ma'noda 'whether' bilan
  almashtirish mumkin.


⚠ 'A GUESS':

  'to guess' (fe'l) = taxmin qilmoq
  'a guess' (ot) = taxmin
  ⚠ 'u' JIM: /ɡes/.

points.en: Listen to the story and check if your guesses were correct.
points.uz: Hikoyani tinglang va taxminlaringiz to'g'ri ekanini tekshiring.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'if' bu yerda 'AGAR' emas, '...MI' ma'nosida.
⚠ 'whether' bilan almashtirish mumkin.

points.en: ⚠ The story is on page 27, so you can also check your guesses by reading.
points.uz: ⚠ Hikoya 27-betda, shuning uchun taxminlarni o'qib ham tekshirish mumkin.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Kassetada shu matn o'qiladi.
⚠ Audio faqat TINGLASh ko'nikmasi uchun kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the story and match the sentences (A - D) to the numbered spaces (1 - 4) in the story, then explain the words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoyani o'qing va gaplarni (A - D) hikoyadagi raqamlangan bo'shliqlarga (1 - 4) moslang, so'ng qalin harfli so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
YETIShMAYOTGAN GAPNI TOPISh.

  ⚠ Hikoya matni 27-betda; unda to'rtta
  raqamlangan bo'shliq bor.


TO'RT GAP:

  A  Janice couldn't see her anywhere,
     so she picked up the flowers, went
     inside and phoned the taxi service
     again to cancel the call.

  B  Janice looked at it and gasped in
     amazement.

  C  Instead of her husband, though,
     Janice saw a young woman standing
     there.

  D  Then James noticed an old
     photograph next to the clock.


⚠ QANDAY TOPILADI - BOG'LOVChI
SO'ZLARGA QARANG:

  C  'Instead of her husband, THOUGH' -
     demak oldin ERI kutilgan bo'lishi
     kerak.

  A  'Janice couldn't see HER anywhere' -
     'her' = yosh ayol, demak oldin
     ayol tilga olingan.

  D  'THEN James noticed ...' -
     ketma-ketlik; James allaqachon
     uyda bo'lishi kerak.

  B  'Janice looked at IT' - 'it' =
     surat, demak oldin surat tilga
     olingan (D dan KEYIN).


⚠ 'INSTEAD OF':

  = ... o'rniga.
  ⚠ 'instead of' + OT yoki -ING.
  ⚠ 'instead' (yolg'iz) = uning o'rniga
  (gap oxirida).


⚠ 'TO GASP IN AMAZEMENT':

  = hayratdan nafasi bo'g'ilmoq.
  ⚠ 'to gasp' = nafasi bo'g'ilmoq,
  hayqirmoq.
  ⚠ 'amazement' = hayrat ('to amaze' -
  hayratda qoldirmoq).


⚠ 'TO PICK UP':

  = yerdan olmoq, ko'tarmoq.
  ⚠ Yana: 'to pick sb up' = mashinada
  borib olmoq.


⚠ 'TO CANCEL':

  = bekor qilmoq.
  ⚠ Britaniyada 'cancelLED' (ikki 'l'),
  AQShda 'canceled'.


⚠ 'ANYWHERE':

  = hech qayerda (inkor gapda).
  ⚠ "couldn't see her ANYWHERE" =
  uni HECh QAYERDA ko'rmadi.
  ⚠ 'nowhere' bilan bir xil ma'no,
  lekin 'nowhere' TASDIQ fe'l bilan
  keladi.
wordList: A - Janice couldn't see her anywhere, so she picked up the flowers, went inside and phoned the taxi service again to cancel the call.
B - Janice looked at it and gasped in amazement.
C - Instead of her husband, though, Janice saw a young woman standing there.
D - Then James noticed an old photograph next to the clock.

items.sentence: Space 1 - Janice opened the door expecting her husband. ___
items.answer: C - Instead of her husband, though, Janice saw a young woman standing there.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'INSTEAD OF her husband' - demak oldin ERI
kutilgan.
⚠ 'though' gap o'rtasida = 'ammo'.

items.sentence: Space 2 - When Janice went back to the door, the flowers were lying on the doormat. ___
items.answer: A - Janice couldn't see her anywhere, so she picked up the flowers, went inside and phoned the taxi service again to cancel the call.
items.uz: 2-bo'shliq - Janice eshikka qaytganda, gullar poyandozda yotardi. ___
items.whyUz:
⚠ "couldn't see HER anywhere" - 'her' = yosh
ayol, demak u allaqachon tilga olingan.
⚠ 'to cancel the call' = chaqiruvni bekor
qilmoq.

items.sentence: Space 3 - James came home and Janice told him what had happened. ___
items.answer: D - Then James noticed an old photograph next to the clock.
items.uz: 3-bo'shliq - Jeyms uyga keldi va Janice unga nima bo'lganini aytdi. ___

items.sentence: Space 4 - He showed her the photograph. ___
items.answer: B - Janice looked at it and gasped in amazement.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'Janice looked at IT' - 'it' = surat, demak
u D dan KEYIN keladi.
⚠ 'to gasp in amazement' = hayratdan nafasi
bo'g'ilmoq.
